Grandma wants a gift list. You want less stuff. Here's the middle ground.

A twist from the research: kids ages 3 to 12 actually got more happiness from things than from experiences.
The reason is memory. Little kids love the zoo while they're there, but need help remembering it.
So give one small thing to unwrap, plus an experience, and print a photo from the day.
